# Contact methods are appended, never replaced — and identical ones dedupe

**Claim.** Emails, phones and addresses in an update are added to what is already there; there is no way to remove one through this endpoint. The append is idempotent for an identical value: re-sending an email the person already has does not create a second entry.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}/post`

## Observed exchange

_A person with one email address._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Imani",
  "lastName": "Oyelaran-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "imani.oyelaran-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Update with a second address. The first is not replaced — the list grows._

```http
POST /people/100000001

{
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "imani.o-{scope}@example.org"
    }
  ]
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```
